_notes: Tolerances are generous on time metrics because CI hardware varies wildly
(GitHub runners are slower than M-series Macs); functional metrics use a
tight tolerance because they're properties of the algorithm, not the host.
regression_direction: 'higher' means a larger measured value is bad;
'lower' means a smaller measured value is bad.

chunker_medium_ms_p50.note: 100% tolerance accommodates CI runner variance; absolute regression > 8 ms still fails.

indexer_files_per_sec_medium.source: bench indexer — medium (500 files) files/s column

warm_search_p50_ms_medium.source: bench indexer — medium (500 files) Search warm p50
warm_search_p50_ms_medium.note: Wide tolerance: <1 ms is the invariant; we only care that it's not >1 ms.

freshness_p50_ms_medium.source: bench freshness — medium (500 files) Save → search-visible p50

session_dedup_session_savings_pct.source: bench session_dedup — total session savings (Σ row)

digest_savings_pct.source: bench digest — median savings across 6 fixtures (cargo-build, cargo-test-green, pnpm-install, yarn-install, pytest-green, gha-log)
